title: DFT study of free radical scavenging mechanisms in UiO-66-(OH)2 and UiO-66-NH2 MOFs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20220-20232
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01568E, Paper
Open Access

Shuai Ke, Bo Wang, Ganggang Liu, Wei Huang, Yubing Gong, Kailin Pan
Combined DFT and DPPH assays rapidly screen MOF-based radioprotectors for free radical scavenging. This approach aligns computational predictions with experiments, enabling fast, cost-effective identification of top candidates.
